## Projects

- [ganji.me](https://ganji.me): my personal blog and portfolio, built from scratch using only vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- [scaffold](https://mohganji.github.io/scaffold/): point an agent at a repo, get a software factory — skills, guardrails, quality gates and a cloud-agent fleet
- [mindmap.io](https://mindmap.io): keyboard first AI-native mindmapping tool. Every node is a prompt and every path a conversation
- [tron.ganji.me](https://tron.ganji.me/): a browser-based 3D Tron arena game built on Three.js, submitted to Vibejam 2026
- [mohganji/skills](https://github.com/MohGanji/skills): packaged agent skills and automations for a fully agentic SDLC
- [Braindump](https://github.com/MohGanji/braindump): an agent-friendly local memory CLI tool built in Go — persistent, searchable memory for AI agents
- [SchemaIran Bot](https://t.me/SchemaIran_Bot): a Telegram bot conducting YSQ tests online — 10k+ results analyzed and published as a research paper
- [Credi](https://credicredi.com): a content credibility analyzer — which voices can you trust on social media
- [JScope](https://github.com/MohGanji/jscope): a VSCode extension measuring and visualizing async code coverage (ESEC/FSE 2023)
- [Daily Timeblock notion template](https://ganjim.gumroad.com/l/daily-timeblock): a Notion template for time blocking and daily logs, inspired by Deep Work
- [BlogFrog](/vibe/blogfrog/): a blog post dispenser — takes you to a random post from my favorite writers

## Vibe projects

Small things built with an AI model in an afternoon; each notes the model that wrote it.

- [World Cup](https://ganji.me/vibe/worldcup/): Tap any badge to see the matchup and result. (opus 4.8, jun 2026)
- [NutriHex](https://ganji.me/vibe/food/): FIFA-style stat hexagons for food — compare ingredients and meals, build dishes, personalize to your diet (fable 5, jun 2026)
- [Keyfall](https://ganji.me/vibe/piano/): synthesia-style piano on your laptop keyboard — play or practice songs and get graded with tips (fable 5, jun 2026)
- [Tech Riddles](https://ganji.me/vibe/tech-riddles/): poetry riddles for computer science major (GPT 5.5, may 2026)
- [Tron: Cyber Cycles](https://ganji.me/vibe/tron/): 3d arena game built on threejs, submitted to <a href="https://vibej.am/2026/" rel="noopener">vibejam/2026</a> (opus 4.6 and composer 2, mar 2026)
- [Globe](https://ganji.me/vibe/globe/): interactive Three.js globe with country and city exploration (gemini 3.1 pro, apr 2026)
- [Stick RPG](https://ganji.me/vibe/stick/): Loading city... (opus 4.6, apr 2026)
- [Gas Log](https://ganji.me/vibe/gas/): gas fill-up tracker with cost and mileage stats (composer 2, apr 2026)
- [Mindmap](https://ganji.me/vibe/mm/): AI-native mindmap where every node is a prompt and every path is a conversation — now lives at <a href="https://mindmap.io" rel="noopener">mindmap.io</a> (opus 4.6, dec 2025–now)
- [Infinite XO](https://ganji.me/vibe/xo/): infinite tic-tac-toe on an expandable board (gemini 2.5 flash, dec 2025)
- [BlogFrog](https://ganji.me/vibe/blogfrog/): Wanna jump into some cool blog? This button takes you to one of 3,261 posts from interesting blogs on the internet. Take Me Somewhere (by hand, jul 2022)
